q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a carrom board?
title: Carrom board carbon footprint per board
short: Add the plywood playing surface, wooden frame, pockets and coins per board with supplier figures. Add cutting, sanding, lacquering and drying energy, then divide the unit's energy by boards made.
audience: Carrom board and indoor game makers

p: Report per board by size and surface thickness, since the plywood is most of the material.

example.title: Worked example: carrom board unit per board (one month)
lines: Plant total: 2,130 / 3,000 = 0.710 kg CO2 per board
Add plywood, frame and lacquer for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
